zh-CN.title: 实验性输入
zh-CN.description: 启用后可配置实验性输入连接器。
zh-CN.instructions: 将相应的 logitech_connector.dll 或 razer_connector.dll 放在 MDA.exe 同目录。修改开关后会自动刷新控制器列表。
zh-CN.testHint: 检测前请保持 MDA 在前台并松开鼠标。倒计时后将移动 4–8 像素并尝试回位；出现异常或干预时立即停止。
zh-CN.running: 任务运行中不能更改设置或检测。
zh-CN.restart: 设置已保存，正在刷新控制器列表。

en-US.title: Experimental input
en-US.description: Enable configuration of experimental input connectors.
en-US.instructions: Place logitech_connector.dll or razer_connector.dll beside MDA.exe. The controller list refreshes after changing this setting.
en-US.testHint: Keep MDA in the foreground and release the mouse. After a countdown, the cursor moves 4–8 pixels and attempts to return; unexpected movement stops the test.
en-US.running: Settings and testing are unavailable while a task is running.
en-US.restart: Setting saved. Refreshing the controller list.
